```artifact
Feature: User-Friendly Consultation Request System
  As a person with no computer background,
  I want to use the system easily and intuitively,
  So that I can fill in a Consultation Request in less than 5 minutes.

  Scenario: User fills in a Consultation Request in less than 5 minutes
    Given the system is ready for a Consultation Request
    When the user fills in the minimal and only relevant questions
    Then the Consultation Request is completed in less than 5 minutes

  Scenario Outline: User navigates the system with a simple and intuitive interface
    Given the system is ready for a Consultation Request
    When the user navigates through the system
    Then the user completes the Consultation Request in <steps> steps or less

    Examples:
      | steps |
      | 5     |
      | 10    |
      | 15    |

  Scenario Outline: User encounters invalid information while filling in the Consultation Request
    Given the system is ready for a Consultation Request
    When the user enters <invalid_information> in the Consultation Request
    Then the system displays an error message "<error_message>"

    Examples:
      | invalid_information | error_message                     |
      | ""                  | "Name cannot be empty"            |
      | "1234567890123456789012345678901234567890" | "Name is too long" |

  Scenario Outline: User encounters edge case information while filling in the Consultation Request
    Given the system is ready for a Consultation Request
    When the user enters <edge_case_information> in the Consultation Request
    Then the Consultation Request is accepted without errors

    Examples:
      | edge_case_information |
      | "A"                   |
      | "John Doe"            |
      | "John_Doe123"         |

  Feature: Documentation for System Installation and Usage
    As a user,
    I want to have an Installation Guide and a User Manual,
    So that I can install and use the system without issues.

    Scenario: Installation Guide is prepared
      Given the system installation process is initiated
      When the user follows the Installation Guide
      Then the system is installed successfully

    Scenario: User Manual is prepared
      Given the system is installed
      When the user refers to the User Manual
      Then the user can perform basic operations in the system
```
